acceptance_rule: Preflight must affect at least 20 settled decisions, at least 3 in every canonical window, at least 2 source families, trigger at least once, retain at least 5% admission survival, and have no benchmark/state gaps. Gate 1 must match the active post-MTM core identity and compare same-run current allocator before versus quarantine after. Accept default-off alpha only if three-window full-system aggregate EV improves by more than 10%, allocator incremental PnL is positive, at least two windows improve with no window EV or PnL regression, max-drawdown worsening is at most 0.5 percentage points, after remains positive versus core in every window, and positive-PnL concentration is at most 50% single-name and 0.35 HHI. DSR is Gate 5/live eligibility only.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Capital-allocation/entry-admission alpha: within the accepted-helper source-priority allocator, maintain an independent fixed-$4k raw-source shadow book against SPY and QQQ. When both benchmark-relative equity curves remain strictly below their own high-water marks for 21 consecutive observable trading sessions, quarantine only that source's new entries before daily top1 selection so healthy lower-priority sources can backfill; continue the shadow book and re-enable only when both curves recover the high-water marks frozen at quarantine. Keep source priority, ranking, five accepted 1.25x scalars, hold, cooldown, costs, execution envelope, exits, and core behavior fixed.
